title: Scrutiny & Filing Congestion Loop
path: no. of cases to file → burden on court staff → scrutiny backlog → time taken in scrutiny → rate of refiling due to errors → share of filings accepted at first submission → no. of cases to file
mechanism: Document filing errors increase scrutiny burdens and processing delays, prompting rushed submissions and more clerical defects.

title: Adjournment & Caseload Compounding Loop
path: caseload → ask for adjournment → frequency of adjournments → backlog → caseload
mechanism: Large dockets stretch dates between hearings, causing scheduling clashes for lawyers, repeated adjournment requests, and an expanded backlog.

title: Evasion, Escalation & Police Overburden Loop
path: magistrate's decision to escalate → rate of warrant execution → burden on police → police effort in pursuing the accused → number of custody cases → taking accountability → magistrate's decision to escalate
mechanism: Persistent non-appearance leads to warrant escalation, which exceeds police execution capacity and allows the accused to evade appearance further.

title: Litigation Fatigue & Attrition Loop
path: case pendancy → time spent by judge per hearing → adjournments frequency → fees → money spent on the case → willingness to contribute → rate of cases closed without recovery → case pendancy
mechanism: Lengthening trial pendency inflates costs and exhausts the complainant, driving case abandonment or heavily discounted settlements without full debt recovery.

title: Early Settlement & Deterrence Loop
path: accuracy of verified address → likelihood accused reads summons → perceived accountability → chances accused appears in court → willingness to pay → use of mediation outside court → understanding demand notice → accuracy of verified address
mechanism: High perceived accountability and prompt statutory notice compliance encourage early mediation settlements, reinforcing standard recovery expectations.

title: Summons Service & Timely Appearance Loop
path: accuracy of verified address → likelihood accused reads summons → perceived accountability → chances accused appears in court → number of hearing occurs → share of summons effectively served
mechanism: Accurate address tracking ensures effective summons delivery, eliminating excuses for non-service and reinforcing consistent court attendance.

title: External Diversion & Mediation Loop
path: share of scheduled hearings that proceed → share of cases referred to mediation → mediation through court → case pendancy → number of hearing occurs
mechanism: Diverts active cases into alternative dispute resolution (Lok Adalat/mediation cells) to clear courtroom caseload and reduce pendency.

title: Non-Appearance Escalation Loop
path: complexity of the case → frequency of adjournments → level of escalation of the case → complexity of the case
mechanism: Accused non-appearance triggers procedural escalation (summons to bailable/non-bailable warrants) to compel physical appearance.

title: Pre-Litigation Notice & Financial Pressure Subsystem
path: accused's unpaid debt → financial pressure on complainant → anxiety about recovering money → motivation to pursue legal action → ease of reaching lawyer → confidence in pursuing case
mechanism: Early creditor journey from bank return memo to statutory legal notice under Section 138, capturing emotional stress, expectations, and postal delivery dependencies before formal court filing.

title: Accused Socio-Economic Drivers & Digital Barriers
path: financial condition → ability to hire a lawyer → ease of understanding documenting process → awareness of consequences
mechanism: Structural constraints including lack of legal aid, work shifts, digital friction with e-courts, and financial weakness driving non-appearance independent of intentional fraud.

title: Warrant Execution, Bail & Disposal Subsystem
path: magistrate's decision to escalate → rate of warrant execution → chances accused is traced → rate of request bail → presence of guarantor
mechanism: Traces warrant execution hurdles, police tracing, bribes/delay tactics, bail bonds, and final case dispositions through sentencing or settlement.
